successCriteria.description: src/shared/date/accrual.ts exports startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining whose behavior is equivalent to the private helpers in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts (and addMonths in src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts): startOfUtcDay returns Date.UTC(y,m,d) of the input's UTC components; addMonths clones, sets UTC date to 1, adds months via setUTCMonth, and clamps the day to the last day of the target month; periodContaining steps accrualMonths periods from the anchor's UTC day start with a 10,000-iteration bound.
src/shared/date/index.ts re-exports startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining so later consumers import from the shared entry point rather than the accrual file directly.

src/shared/types/index.ts exports an EmployeeProfile interface with exactly id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, role: EmployeeRole, managerId: string | null, department, hireDate: Date, employmentStatus: EmploymentStatus — and no passwordHash or terminationDate — and LeaveRequestQueryParams gains employeeIds?: string[].

tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts passes under Jest and covers startOfUtcDay, addMonths (including month-end clamping, e.g. Jan 31 + 1 month), and periodContaining (including the ConflictError when date < anchor and the 10,000-iteration bound), with a describe block setting process.env.TZ = 'Asia/Riyadh' to prove UTC-only behavior is unaffected by the host timezone.

constraints: Copy the three helpers verbatim from src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts (and addMonths from src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts); do not change their arithmetic, error messages, or the 10,000-iteration safety bound.

periodContaining must throw ConflictError when date < anchor (message 'Requested date precedes the accrual anchor') and when the period cannot be resolved within the bound (message 'Unable to resolve accrual period').
Do NOT refactor src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts or src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts to import the new shared helpers in this phase — that is deferred to a later phase.
EmployeeProfile must omit passwordHash and terminationDate; it reuses the existing EmployeeRole and EmploymentStatus enums from src/shared/types/index.ts rather than re-declaring them.
The accrual utility must import ConflictError from src/shared/errors/index.ts (the existing 409/CONFLICT error), not define a local error type.
outOfScope: Refactoring leave.service.ts or balance.service.ts to consume the shared date helpers (deferred to a later phase).
Any routes, controllers, RBAC enforcement, database access, migrations, or audit/notification side effects — this phase is pure shared code and types.
Adding passwordHash or terminationDate to EmployeeProfile (both are intentionally excluded from the profile shape).

entityInvariants.invariant: A profile value must never carry passwordHash or terminationDate; it exposes only the ten non-sensitive identity/employment fields and reuses the canonical EmployeeRole and EmploymentStatus enums.

For a valid date >= anchor, returns { start, end } where start is the UTC day start of the anchor and end = addMonths(start, accrualMonths), with start <= date < end; throws ConflictError when date < anchor or when no period is found within 10,000 iterations.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Pure, no side effects; returns a new Date at UTC midnight of the input's UTC year/month/day.
Pure, no side effects; returns a new Date (does not mutate the input) with the day clamped to the last day of the target month.

interfaceConstraints.operation: periodContaining(anchor: Date, accrualMonths: number, date: Date): { start: Date; end: Date }
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Pure; throws ConflictError (409/CONFLICT) when date < anchor or when the period cannot be resolved within the 10,000-iteration bound.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining must be behaviorally identical to the private implementations in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts (and addMonths in src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts), including the exact ConflictError messages and the 10,000-iteration bound.

EmployeeProfile must reference the existing EmployeeRole and EmploymentStatus enums (not new local types), and LeaveRequestQueryParams.employeeIds must extend the existing interface without altering its other fields.
The accrual utility must throw the existing ConflictError (statusCode 409, code 'CONFLICT') exported from the shared errors entry point.

integrationPoints.why: periodContaining throws the existing ConflictError (409/CONFLICT) for date-before-anchor and unresolvable-period cases.
EmployeeProfile reuses EmployeeRole and EmploymentStatus; LeaveRequestQueryParams gains employeeIds for later leave-read scoping.
Source of the verbatim helper implementations; they remain unmodified in this phase but will later import the shared helpers.
